assessment.headline: DAY 30. One month of war. 4,600+ dead. India cut excise, rupee at ATL, LPG choking. April 6 = 8 days.
assessment.body:
One month. 4,600+ people are dead across 7+ countries. 2,800+ distinct attacks have hit 29 of Iran's 31 provinces. The IRGC is now threatening US university campuses in the Gulf. US anti-tank land mines have been found in a residential area of Shiraz. 9 paramedics were killed in Lebanon in a single day. Russia is feeding Iran satellite intelligence on US military positions.

Iran is allowing 20 Pakistani-flagged ships through Hormuz (2/day) — a positive signal through the Pakistan mediation channel. But 3 ships were turned back earlier this week and Iran's parliament is writing toll fees into permanent law. The blockade remains selectively enforced.

For India — this is now a full domestic crisis:
• Excise duty slashed ₹10/L on petrol+diesel — govt calls it 'huge revenue hit,' likens situation to COVID
• Rupee at 94.79 — all-time low. RBI has burned $12-15 billion from forex reserves. Reserves down $19B in 2 weeks
• Indian crude basket at $125/barrel. Macquarie: 40% probability of $200 oil
• 91% of LPG comes from Gulf — supply is choking. 75% of food service industry depends on LPG = ₹1,200-1,300 Cr/day in losses
• FII outflow $11B+ in March. ₹44L+ Cr destroyed. Sensex fell 5th straight week
• CSMonitor: 'India is biggest loser in a war it isn't even fighting.' Pakistan mediates while India is absent from diplomacy
• 10 million Indians in Gulf countries — remittances ($40B/year) at risk. Indian sailor stranded a month in Gulf

April 6 is 8 days away. The 15-point US plan and Iran's 5-point counter are miles apart. If Pakistan-mediated talks produce nothing: power plant strikes resume, Hormuz closes completely, and India enters uncharted territory.
